name: Workey
notes: Aggregator. The about page says it collects jobs with automatic crawlers, open APIs and direct publishing, which describes how jobs come in, not an API offered to employers. Operated by a sole proprietorship (enskild firma). Employer pricing not stated; the contact page only offers to explain advertising.

review.note: Home, employer, about and contact pages read in the browser reader; no pricing or developer page found.
